limitations: Original-reference excess unavailable: exact timestamp matched benchmark trades not established.

Equal-horizon sensitivity is the same19:40–20:00UTC window for each original scored group. The same stock return repeated with different earlier scores is not an independent trial.
SPCX sector proxy is unresolved for this day; its sector excess stays null. Other31 symbols retain fixed sector ETF mapping. Premarket sector baseline gaps remain null.

No scores>=60 were published today; high-score-loser sample under that fixed definition is empty, not evidence of accuracy. Disconfirming original-reference examples:09:00 UNH45 -1.516%, PG50 -0.139%, while FCX15 +2.250% and GE15 +1.601%;14:30 KO55 -0.008%,LLY45 -0.723%, versus AVGO35 +0.553%.

One-day/minute-endpoint diagnostics do not test the intended several-day horizon. No stable positive score-return ranking is established; correlation, thin premarket selection, unequal horizons and publication delay are limitations, not proof of predictive edge.
